name: miami-drift
description: Fast run out of downtown Miami to the airport on the Dolphin Expressway (SR-836), Valhalla-snapped to real roads and driven at ~80 mph so Life360 catches sustained high speed instead of just the teleport. Mostly limited-access expressway (few sharp turns) so 80 mph stays believable and validates. Sets up the future 'arrive at the airport' story.
